audit.description: The changed production file tx2/wrapper.py replaces `from tqdm.autonotebook import tqdm` with `import progressbar` and changes both progress loops to call `progressbar.progressbar(..., max_value=len(...))`, which is meaningful target-library API use for progressbar2. The static and dynamic evidence show no source imports from the production repo, and the only observed `tqdm` imports came from third-party dependencies outside the repo. Dynamic target evidence resolves `progressbar` to site-packages/progressbar/__init__.py with `target_local_spec_count` 0, so there is no local fake provider indicated.
evidence: Unified diff: tx2/wrapper.py removes `from tqdm.autonotebook import tqdm` and adds `import progressbar`.
Unified diff: tx2/wrapper.py changes two loops from `tqdm(..., total=len(...))` to `progressbar.progressbar(..., max_value=len(...))`.
Dynamic metrics: `first_target_events_from_repo` records target import and target attr access in tx2/wrapper.py, with origin under site-packages/progressbar.
reasons: Changed production code imports and calls the real progressbar API from progressbar2.
Changed production code no longer imports or references tqdm.
Observed source imports are only from dependencies, not repo production code.
No local target provider or shim was detected.
